# Euro Liga-Hub mit Aside (Phase 3) — Design

**Datum:** 2026-05-11
**Scope:** UI-Refactor für `euroIsolated`-Mode (Spain-Save). NBA-Mode bleibt unangetastet.
**Vorgänger:** Phase 2.5 (Sim+W-L) — gleaming-wibbling-sky.md.

## Problem

Im Spain Euro-Isolated Save fehlen Hubs für Euroleague und Liga Endesa. Die existierende `CompetitionView` zeigt nur Standings + Recent-Results, kein Bracket, keine Comp-spezifischen Analytics. NBA-Sidebar-Sections (NBA Cup, All-Star, NBA Central, Draft, Hall of Fame, Trade-Stack) sind in Spain entweder nicht relevant oder reduziert. Der User will eine schlankere, FM-style Hub-Architektur.

## Ziel-Architektur

### Linke Sidebar (in `euroIsolated` Mode, 6 Sections)

1. **MY TEAM** — Schedule · Team Office · Coaching · Training Center
2. **MY LEAGUES** — Euroleague · Liga Endesa
3. **COMMUNICATIONS** — Inbox · Messages · Social Feed · League News
4. **PLAYERS** — Transactions · Player Search · Player Comparison · Free Agents
5. **OPERATIONS** — Team Finances
6. **SPORTSBOOK** — Sports Book

NBA-Mode behält die existierende Multi-Group-Struktur. Gating per `euroIsolated && getEffectiveUiMode === 'euro_isolated'` in `NavigationMenu.tsx:128-281`.

### Liga-Hub Layout (Euroleague + Liga Endesa)

```
┌─ Sidebar ────┐ ┌─ Main ─────────────────┐ ┌─ Aside ─────────────┐
│ My Team      │ │ Euroleague · Bracket    │ │ LEAGUE              │
│ My Leagues   │ │                         │ │  ▸ Bracket (default)│
│  ★ Euroleague│ │ [QF] [SF] [Final 4]     │ │  ▸ Standings        │
│  Liga Endesa │ │  cards                  │ │ ANALYTICS           │
│ Comms        │ │                         │ │  ▸ Player Stats     │
│ Players      │ │                         │ │  ▸ Team Stats       │
│ Operations   │ │                         │ │  ▸ Top Scorers      │
│ Sportsbook   │ │                         │ │  ▸ MVP Race         │
└──────────────┘ │                         │ │ DRAMA               │
                 │                         │ │  ▸ News             │
                 │                         │ │  ▸ Recent Results   │
                 │                         │ │  ▸ Awards           │
                 └─────────────────────────┘ └─────────────────────┘
```

Aside erscheint NUR wenn `currentView ∈ {'Euroleague', 'Liga Endesa'}`. Andere Tabs (Team Office, Sportsbook, etc.) rendern volle Main-Breite ohne Aside.

Aside-Click ersetzt die Main-Area (bleibt im Liga-Hub-Kontext). Sub-View-State lebt lokal im Hub-Component (per Liga gekeyed).

## Reused Components

- **`CompetitionView`** (`src/components/competition/CompetitionView.tsx`) — wird zur Standings-Sub-View hinter dem Aside-Item "Standings".
- **`SeriesCard`, `BracketColumn`** (`src/components/playoffs/bracket/`) — direkt in CompetitionBracketView importiert. Akzeptieren `series: PlayoffSeries`, `teams: NBATeam[]` — wir bauen Adapter, der `competitionResolver`-Output → `PlayoffSeries`-Shape mappt und `nonNBATeams` als `NBATeam[]`-Slot übergibt.
- **`competitionResolver.resolveCompetitionSeason()`** (`src/services/competition/competitionResolver.ts:397`) — liefert `standings + knockoutMatches + playInMatches + championTid + …`. Bracket-View ruft das auf, generiert Round-Spalten daraus.
- **`PlayerStatsView`, `TeamStatsView`, `LeagueLeadersView`, `AwardRacesView`** — werden mit comp-Filter (tid-Range pro spec.id) gerendert. Wo Filter-Prop nicht existiert, thin Wrapper bauen, der `state.players` lokal vorfiltert.

## New Files

```
src/components/competition/
├── CompetitionHubLayout.tsx       # Wrapper mit Aside + Sub-View-Switcher
├── CompetitionAside.tsx           # Right Aside — Sub-Item-Liste
├── CompetitionBracketView.tsx     # Liga-Bracket aus competitionResolver
└── (CompetitionView.tsx)          # bestehend, wird Standings-Sub-View
```

## Changed Files

```
src/types.ts                                    # Tab union: 'Liga Endesa' (neu), 'Euroleague' (existiert)
src/components/sidebar/NavigationMenu.tsx       # 6-Section euroIsolated-Branch
src/components/layout/MainContent.tsx           # Routing: 'Euroleague' + 'Liga Endesa' → CompetitionHubLayout
```

## Sub-View Routing (im Hub)

| Aside-Item | Component | Filter |
|---|---|---|
| Bracket (default) | `CompetitionBracketView` | `competitionId` |
| Standings | `CompetitionView` (existing) | `specId` |
| Player Stats | `PlayerStatsView` wrapped | tid range pro Liga (Endesa: 5000-5999, EL: 1000-1999) |
| Team Stats | `TeamStatsView` wrapped | tid range |
| Top Scorers | `LeagueLeadersView` wrapped | tid range |
| MVP Race | `AwardRacesView` wrapped | tid range |
| News | New stub: filter `state.news` by competitionId | competitionId |
| Recent Results | Reuses CompetitionView's recent-results panel | competitionId |
| Awards | New stub | competitionId |

**Phase-1-Scope:** Bracket + Standings live, Rest als "Coming Soon"-Stubs (außer wenn der existing View einen `compFilter`-Prop schon hat → dann live wired).

## Slices

1. **Slice 1 — Sidebar 6-Section:** `NavigationMenu.tsx` euroIsolated-Branch. Type-Union ergänzt um `'Liga Endesa'`. Keine Verhaltensänderung in NBA-Mode.
2. **Slice 2 — `CompetitionBracketView`:** Adapter `competitionResolver → PlayoffSeries-shape`, `BracketColumn` direkt importiert. Bracket zeigt "TBD"-Karten während Group Stage, real-Karten nach KO-Start.
3. **Slice 3 — `CompetitionHubLayout` + `CompetitionAside`:** Layout-Wrapper, Sub-View-State lokal, Aside-Items mit aktive-Highlights.
4. **Slice 4 — MainContent Routing:** `case 'Euroleague'` + `case 'Liga Endesa'` → `CompetitionHubLayout specId={…}`.
5. **Slice 5 — Sub-View Stubs:** Standings live, Rest "Coming Soon". Folge-Slice für Analytics-Wiring.

## Out of Scope (Folge-Slices)

- Comp-spezifische Player/Team-Stats-Wiring (Slice 5 nur Stub).
- Mobile-Layout der Aside (initial: Aside collapse auf <md).
- News-Filter pro Liga (Stub).
- All-Tournament-Team UI für EL Final Four.
- Saisonende-Snapshot in `competitionHistory.standings`.

## Verification

1. `npx tsc --noEmit` → keine neuen Errors.
2. Spain-Save laden → Sidebar zeigt 6 Sections.
3. Euroleague-Tab → Hub mit Bracket + Aside (Bracket aktiv).
4. Aside → Standings → Tabelle erscheint in Main.
5. Liga Endesa-Tab → analoger Hub, Endesa-Bracket-Format (Bo3/Bo5/Bo5).
6. NBA-Save laden → Sidebar unverändert (alte Multi-Group-Struktur).

The plumbing works; this handoff is a deep audit pass + gameplay polish. Be ruthless about reading actual save state before assuming anything (see CLAUDE.md DevTools snippet).

## What was just shipped (read these files first)

- `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-11-euro-liga-hub-aside-design.md` — design intent
- `src/components/competition/` — `CompetitionHubLayout`, `CompetitionAside`, `CompetitionBracketView`, `CompetitionCentralView`, `CompetitionHistoryView`, `CompetitionView`, `hubContext.ts`
- `src/data/euroleagueHistoryFetcher.ts` — generic gist fetcher for EL + Endesa history (champions, MVPs, awards, season-string inference, trophy-cabinet aggregation)

- `src/utils/leagueLabels.ts` — euro-isolated mode flag added (no more "NBA Injuries" leaking into Spain saves)
- `src/services/simulation/GameSimulator/engine.ts:1485` — `buildNonNBATeam` now runs for `competitionId` games (not only preseason)
- `src/services/simulationService.ts` — competition games skip the NBA wins/losses mutation block

---

## Audit checklist — do these in order

### 1. Sim correctness for Euroleague + Endesa

Spain save, advance time and verify:

- [ ] Schedule view: EL & Endesa games actually flip `played:true` after the date passes (use the DevTools snippet in CLAUDE.md to read `state.schedule`).
- [ ] `state.boxScores` contains entries with `competitionId === 'euroleague'` and `competitionId === 'endesa'` after a multi-day sim.
- [ ] `competitionResolver.resolveCompetitionSeason()` returns sensible standings (W/L sums match boxscore counts) — call it from the console with the active spec + boxScores.
- [ ] `injectCompetitionPostseasonGames` actually injects QF/SF/Final games at the spec's `playoffFormat.rounds.start` date. Bo3 (Endesa QF), Bo5 (Endesa SF/Final, EL QF), Bo1 (EL Final Four SF + Final) are honored.
- [ ] `KNOBS_EUROLEAGUE` produces realistic EL scores (~75-85 pace) — log a sample of `simResults.results` and eyeball.
- [ ] Player stats for Real Madrid roster get accumulated in `player.stats[]` correctly. Watch for double-count when a player appears in BOTH a domestic Endesa game AND a continental EL game on the same day (should be two separate stat rows by `season+tid` if tid differs, but if Real Madrid keeps the same tid across comps, the rows merge — decide whether that's correct).

### 2. Award races — pool & calculator coverage

Open Aside → MVP Race in Spain save:

- [ ] Verify each enabled award's `poolId` matches the hub it belongs to. Spain template's award catalog should have `mvp` (poolId=`euroleague` or `endesa`?), `dpoy`, `coy`, `rising`, `young`, `top-scorer-ppg`, `rebounds`, `assists`, `pir`, `all-el`, `finals-mvp`, `f4-mvp`. Currently many show **empty** in the EL hub — investigate `services/awards/calculators.ts` and confirm the calculators iterate `nonNBATeams` clubs, not just NBA tids.
- [ ] `pool.ts` `case 'euroleague'` adds Endesa-tid clubs (5xxx) too (Real Madrid + Barça). Confirm the calculators consume that union.
- [ ] Odds formula in `calculators.ts:44-48` mixes percent (top-3) and American moneyline (rest). Decide on a single format and document.
- [ ] PIR (FIBA Performance Index Rating) calculator exists? If yes, verify formula. If no, add — it's the canonical EL/Endesa stat.

### 3. Liga-Hub Aside views — comp-scoping

Each Aside item must show comp-only data when the user is in the EL or Endesa hub:

- [ ] **Bracket** ✓ (uses `competitionResolver` + `state.boxScores` filter). Verify the Sim buttons (`Sim Round`, `Sim to Champion`) actually advance to the right date.
- [ ] **Standings** ✓ (CompetitionView reads boxScores directly).
- [ ] **Central** ✓ (CompetitionCentralView).
- [ ] **Team History** ✓ (filters externalTeamsAsNBA on `league` field via hubLeagueFilter).
- [ ] **Player Stats / Player Ratings / Team Stats / League Leaders / Stat Feats / Power Rankings / Injuries** — all should consume `CompetitionHubLeagueTabContext` and filter via `getTeamsForLeagueTab(state, hubLeagueTab)`. Player Stats + Player Ratings + Team Stats + League Leaders + Power Rankings already do; verify Stat Feats and Injuries.
- [ ] **MVP Race** — uses pool-aware filter; verify NBA candidates never leak into the EL hub.
- [ ] **History** ✓ (CompetitionHistoryView with portrait resolver, club-logo lookup, alias map for Barça etc.).

### 4. Trophy Cabinet — TeamHistoryView

Open Real Madrid in TeamHistoryView from the Aside (in either hub):

- [ ] Counts should be approximately: 11 Euroleague titles, 38 Liga Endesa titles. If lower, the `matchesClub()` token-overlap in `getTrophyCabinet()` is missing aliases (e.g. "Regal FC Barcelona" vs "FC Barcelona").
- [ ] Verify other clubs (Panathinaikos, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi, Olympiacos, Žalgiris) get the right counts.

### 5. Sim plumbing & lazy-sim integration

- [ ] `lazySimRunner.ts` — does it advance EL/Endesa games when the user uses the global "Sim 1 Month" button outside the hub? Currently `simulateDayGames` runs them through the normal engine path, but a lazy bulk-sim might skip `competitionId` games. Trace the path.
- [ ] `seasonRollover.ts` — at year-end, persist a snapshot of EL + Endesa final standings, champion, runners-up into `competitionHistory[seasonId].standings`. Currently nothing writes there; the next season's "History" Aside should still see this season's results.
- [ ] Player retirement / contract roll for non-NBA players — does `seasonRollover` handle Endesa/EL roster turnover, or do clubs get stuck with the same 12 players forever?

### 6. Save format & migration

- [ ] Older saves from before Phase 2.5 should still load. `state.boxScores` previously had no competitionId tags on EL/Endesa games (because they weren't simulated). Don't crash, but the History/Bracket views will be empty until new games sim — acceptable.
- [ ] `clubAliasMap` — verify Spain template populates it (Real Madrid/Barça each have one entry mapping the EL-side tid to the Endesa-side tid). If missing, EL team-stats views show 0 teams.

### 7. UX polish (mobile + desktop)

- [ ] Mobile: Aside is a horizontal scroll pill bar above main content. Verify all 13 items fit and scroll smoothly on a 360px viewport.
- [ ] Bracket: scroll arrows visible only on `md+`. Trophy-center for Final has spring animation.
- [ ] CompetitionHistoryView right-detail panel is `xl:sticky xl:top-4 xl:self-start` — confirm it stays visible while the user scrolls the champions list.
- [ ] Liga hub re-mount preserves Aside selection (module-level `persistedHubView` in `CompetitionHubLayout.tsx`).
- [ ] When user switches Euroleague ↔ Liga Endesa, comp-aware sub-views auto-refresh via `CompetitionHubLeagueTabContext` (Player Stats, Team Stats, Player Ratings, Power Rankings, League Leaders).

## Gameplay improvements — prioritized backlog

**P0 — Blocks the save being playable**

1. **EL/Endesa schedule continuity.** After the regular season ends and the playoff bracket injects, ensure NO regular-season game leaks past `seasonEnd`. Investigate `competitionScheduler.ts` and the postseason injection in `simulationHandler.ts:289-294`.
2. **Roster sync between Endesa and EL teams** for clubs that play both (Real Madrid, Barça, etc.). Players should appear on both rosters; transactions affect both. Check `clubAliasMap` consumers.
3. **AI free-agency for non-NBA leagues.** `AIFreeAgentHandler` runs NBA-only. Endesa/EL free agents either rot or are auto-resigned silently. Decide: do EL clubs even have FA in this sim, or is roster fixed for the season?

**P1 — Polish that makes it feel real**

4. **PIR-based MVP race.** EL MVP is by Performance Index Rating, not BPM/PER. Implement the FIBA PIR formula in `calculators.ts` and wire to the EL-MVP / PIR-Leader award definitions.
5. **Coach of the Year for EL/Endesa.** EL coaches don't exist in the save's `state.staff` — either spawn placeholder coaches per club (with name + tid) or skip the COY award when the calculator finds no eligible coaches.
6. **Champion-history persistence.** At season rollover, append `{ season, championTid, runnerUpTid, mvpId, finalsMvpId, allELTeamIds[] }` into a new `state.competitionHistory[specId][season]` slice so the History Aside view can show user-saved seasons without depending on the gist.
7. **Game-log entries for EL/Endesa games.** `state.history` (the global feed) gets only NBA simResults — no entries when "Real Madrid 88-72 Barcelona" sims. Hook into the boxscore writer.

**P2 — Visual / depth**

8. **Real club logos** — `nonNBATeams[].imgURL` is sometimes missing for smaller clubs. Audit the Spain template `competitions.ts` and fill from official logos.
9. **EL Final Four** — currently rendered as Bo1 SF + Bo1 Final via `competitionResolver`. Confirm the bracket UI labels it "Final Four" not "Semifinal" (currently uses generic "Semifinals" header). Cosmetic.
10. **Trophy Cabinet expansion** — show top players who won MVP / Finals MVP for that club historically (cross-reference EL+Endesa gist `Season_MVP` etc. with club name).
11. **"Open Bio" from History view** — clicking a player name (Kendrick Nunn, Bogdanović etc.) in CompetitionHistoryView should open their `PlayerBioView` if they exist in `state.players`. Currently the chip is read-only.

**P3 — Architecture**

12. **Generic CompetitionHistoryView vs LeagueHistoryView merge.** Consider fusing into one component with a `source` provider (gist for EL/Endesa, `state.historicalAwards` for NBA). Today they're parallel.
13. **`PlayerBioView` in euroIsolated** correctly skips ALL gist enrichment (✓ shipped). Verify retired EL players also don't try to fetch ZenGM bios.
14. **Module-level state in `CompetitionHubLayout` (persistedHubView)** is a code smell. Consider a small Zustand or Context-based store if more views need to share state.

---

## How to run the audit

1. `npm run dev` → load a Spain save 6+ months in (so postseason has triggered).
2. Open DevTools, paste the snippet from `CLAUDE.md → Standard snippet — load newest save and inspect a player`.
3. For each P0/P1 item, dump the relevant slice and verify against the expected behavior.
4. `npx tsc --noEmit` after every change. Pre-existing errors in `DraftSimulatorView`, `fictionalLeagueGenerator`, `GameContext.tsx EXPANSION` cases, and `initialization.ts` (NonNBATeam.cid optional) are NOT yours to fix in this pass — note them but don't touch.

- Don't add new files unless absolutely necessary — reuse existing components (NBACupView's BracketDisplay is already mined for CompetitionBracketView).

- All P0 items either fixed or escalated with a written `## Open Question` block in this file.
- `npm run dev` → Spain save → click through every Aside item in both Euroleague and Liga Endesa hubs without a console error.

- Awards announced at season-end and written to `state.historicalAwards` with the right comp scope.
- `git diff --stat` is reviewed; no unrelated drift.

Good luck. Ping back with the open-questions block before merging.

## UI surface — internals stay internal

Multipliers, deltas, formulas, and intermediate scores are implementation details. Do not surface them to the user. The UI should describe outcomes in words, not equations.

Bad: `Market score: 1.44 = Prestige × 1.00 × Success × 1.20 × Star × 1.20`
Good: `🔥 Hot market — Capital-city prestige · Coming off a Euroleague Final Four · Luka Doncic draws premium sponsors`

Rule of thumb: if a number on screen only makes sense once the reader knows the formula behind it, replace it with a label, a badge, or descriptive bullets. Keep the math in code and tests.

## Don't

- Don't add error handling/fallbacks for impossible scenarios (see global instructions).
- Don't write multi-paragraph docstrings — one short line max.
- Don't auto-run trim/cut logic without checking for the **family-ties protection** (`hasFamilyOnRoster`) — siblings/relatives are untouchable in nepotism passes.
- Don't expose internal multipliers / market scores / deltas in user-facing UI (see "UI surface — internals stay internal" above).

---
name: UI — internals stay internal
description: Don't surface multipliers, deltas, formulas, or intermediate scores in user-facing UI — describe outcomes in words/badges
type: feedback
---

Multipliers, deltas, formulas, and intermediate scores are implementation details. The UI must describe outcomes in words, badges, or descriptive bullets — never raw equations.

Bad: `Market score: 1.44 = Prestige × 1.00 × Success × 1.20 × Star × 1.20`
Good: `🔥 Hot market — Capital-city prestige · Coming off a Euroleague Final Four · Luka Doncic draws premium sponsors`

**Why:** During the Euro tycoon sponsorship redesign brainstorm (May 12 2026), the first mockup showed raw multiplier rows ("Prestige × 1.00", "Star Power +20%", "Market score: 1.44"). User pushed back: "das ist internal bitte.. kein computations.. macht es user firendly". Numbers on screen that only make sense once you know the formula behind them break immersion and signal-to-noise.

**How to apply:** When designing any UI that surfaces a derived value (sponsor outlook, mood, trade likelihood, prestige, momentum, recovery, etc.) — keep the math in code/tests, expose it as a label/badge/bullet list. Rule of thumb: if a number on screen requires the reader to know the formula, replace it. Codified in CLAUDE.md under "UI surface — internals stay internal".

# Euro Sponsorship Redesign — Phase 1

**Status:** Awaiting AC sign-off
**Date:** 2026-05-12
**Scope:** Foundation layer for the full Deep sponsorship system. Phase 2 (industries + conflicts) and Phase 3 (offseason task + alternatives modal + TV-pool) follow in separate PRs.

## Phase 1 goals

1. Expand from 3 slots to **8 slots** (kit / sleeve / back / shorts / stadium / training / court / practice).
2. **Fix the tier-lookup bug** that seeds Real Madrid as Tier D (currently shows €100k/yr sponsor values instead of €3M).
3. Recalibrate the **tier × slot value tables** to realistic Euroleague levels (Tier S ≈ €13M floor total, Tier D ≈ €0.47M floor total).
4. Add **`cityPrestige` field** to `TycoonState` and use it as a baseline multiplier (decouples value from tier-only).
5. Add **signing bonus** to `Sponsorship` interface (UI display only this phase — math wires up in Phase 2).
6. UI polish: `SponsorshipCard` shows the 8 slots compactly. `SponsorshipNegotiationModal` slot-tabs handle 8 instead of 3.
7. Save migration: old 3-slot saves auto-extend to 8 slots; new slots seed at a fallback value (no sudden cash injection).
8. Update `scripts/test-tycoon-sponsor.ts` to cover new schema.

**Explicitly out of scope for Phase 1:**
- Industries + conflict rules (Phase 2)
- Multiple competing offers in modal (Phase 3)
- Offseason `SPONSORSHIPS_REVIEW` task card (Phase 3)
- Star-power detection & multiplier (Phase 2)
- TV-rights market-share pool (Phase 3)

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1** — A new save with Real Madrid as user team shows sponsor values in the millions (kit ≥ €3M/yr, stadium ≥ €3.5M/yr), not €100k.
- **AC2** — A new save with Granada (Tier D) as user team still shows small sponsor values (kit < €200k/yr).
- **AC3** — `SponsorshipCard` renders all 8 slots in a single card, mobile-friendly (no horizontal scroll on a 360px viewport).
- **AC4** — `SponsorshipNegotiationModal` has 8 slot-tabs, each shows a market offer with `valuePerYear`, `signingBonus`, and `years`. Accept/Decline buttons work.
- **AC5** — An existing 3-slot save loads without crash and now reports 8 slots (the 5 new ones seeded as low-value fallback deals).
- **AC6** — `cityPrestige` is set for every team during migration: Madrid/Barcelona ≈ 1.0, Valencia/Baskonia ≈ 0.8, Bilbao/Gran Canaria ≈ 0.6, Manresa/Andorra ≈ 0.4, Granada/Breogán ≈ 0.3.
- **AC7** — `scripts/test-tycoon-sponsor.ts` passes with the new 8-slot schema.
- **AC8** — `LeagueFinancesView` Euro-branch sums all 8 sponsorship slots (not just the legacy 3) when displaying total sponsorship revenue.
- **AC9** — No regression in NBA-mode finances views — the 8-slot logic is gated by `isEuroIsolatedMode(state)`.

## Tier × slot value table (€/yr floor)

| Slot      | Tier S | Tier A | Tier B | Tier C | Tier D |
|-----------|--------|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Kit       | 3,500k | 1,200k | 500k   | 250k   | 120k   |
| Sleeve    | 2,000k | 700k   | 300k   | 150k   | 70k    |
| Back      | 1,500k | 500k   | 200k   | 100k   | 50k    |
| Shorts    | 800k   | 300k   | 100k   | 50k    | 20k    |
| Stadium   | 4,000k | 1,500k | 600k   | 300k   | 150k   |
| Training  | 600k   | 250k   | 100k   | 50k    | 30k    |
| Court     | 400k   | 150k   | 60k    | 30k    | 15k    |
| Practice  | 300k   | 100k   | 40k    | 20k    | 10k    |
| **Total** | **13.1M** | **4.7M** | **1.9M** | **0.95M** | **0.47M** |

## City prestige table

| Tier | Clubs | Prestige |
|------|-------|----------|
| S    | Real Madrid, Barcelona                                    | 1.00 |
| A    | Valencia, Baskonia, Joventut, Unicaja                     | 0.80 |
| B    | Bilbao, Gran Canaria, Tenerife, Murcia, Zaragoza, Burgos  | 0.55 |
| C    | Manresa, Andorra                                          | 0.40 |
| C/D  | Breogán, Granada                                          | 0.30 |

Prestige multiplier applies as `floor × cityPrestige` during seeding and renewal offer generation. (In Phase 1 the formula is `floor × prestige × (0.9 + rand × 0.3)` — the prestige column above replaces the prior implicit tier-only logic.)

## File map

**Modify:**
- `src/types/tycoon.ts` — `SponsorshipSlot` union (3 → 8), `Sponsorship.signingBonus` field, `Sponsorship.industry` field (typed but unused this phase), `TycoonState.cityPrestige` field
- `src/services/tycoon/specs/spain.ts` — `TierBase.sponsorshipFloor` becomes per-slot map (8 entries), new `CITY_PRESTIGE: Record<string, number>` table, new `getCityPrestige(name)` helper
- `src/services/tycoon/sponsorshipEngine.ts` — `getMarketOffer`/`seedInitialSponsorships` iterate over 8 slots, apply `cityPrestige`, include `signingBonus` in offer return
- `src/services/tycoon/migrate.ts` — 3→8-slot upgrade path, `cityPrestige` backfill, tier-lookup fix
- `src/components/tycoon/SponsorshipCard.tsx` — render 8 slots in a 2-column grid (mobile: single column)
- `src/components/tycoon/SponsorshipNegotiationModal.tsx` — slot-tab list of 8, signing-bonus row in offer panel
- `src/components/central/view/LeagueFinancesView.tsx` (or equivalent) — sum sponsorship revenue across all 8 slots in the Euro branch
- `src/services/tycoon/budgetEngine.ts` — `slotRev` already iterates over 3; replace with 8-entry sum
- `scripts/test-tycoon-sponsor.ts` — extend assertions to cover 8 slots + cityPrestige

**Create:** none in Phase 1.

## Implementation order

1. Types (`SponsorshipSlot` union + `cityPrestige` + `signingBonus`).
2. Specs (`spain.ts` floor table + prestige table + helper).
3. Sponsorship engine (seed + market offer over 8 slots).
4. Migration (3→8 + prestige backfill + tier fix).
5. budgetEngine `slotRev` over 8 slots.
6. UI: `SponsorshipCard` (compact 8-slot layout).
7. UI: `SponsorshipNegotiationModal` (8 tabs + signing-bonus row).
8. UI: `LeagueFinancesView` Euro-branch aggregation fix.
9. Tests in `scripts/test-tycoon-sponsor.ts`.
10. Manual smoke test in browser: start fresh Madrid save → verify AC1; load an old 3-slot save → verify AC5.

## Open questions

None — all axes resolved in the brainstorm. If conflicts arise during implementation, I'll pause and ask before guessing.

# Plan: Euro Medical Budget + Dynamic Tier

> Status: **DRAFT — AC sign-off pending**
> Owner: claude + user
> Created: 2026-05-12 (Session post-Phase-1-Sponsorship)
> Related: [euro-sponsorship-phase1.md](./euro-sponsorship-phase1.md), [TODO.md NEXT SESSION section](../TODO.md)

## Goal

Two coupled features that move the Euro-Tycoon system from a *static-tier-lookup* model to a *Football-Manager-style dynamic progression* model:

1. **Medical Budget Slider** — user invests annual EUR in medical/recovery staff. Investment lowers `injuryRate` (prevention) and `gamesRemaining` (recovery time). Same UX as the existing sponsorship/ticket-price sliders, plumbed into `InjurySystem.ts`.

2. **Dynamic Tier via Investment-Score** — `team.tycoon.tier` is no longer a permanent lookup from `getTierForClub(clubName)`. It becomes a **derived field** from a new `prestigeScore (0..1)` that blends rolling spending levels + recent on-court success + city prestige. Like FM: a 3rd-division club can climb to Champions League if the owner keeps investing.

Both ship in a single plan because **the medical slider is a spending dial that feeds the investment score** — implementing them separately would mean redoing the investment-aggregation step twice.

---

## Why both at once

- Medical Budget is a new annual cash-out. It belongs in `BudgetContext` + `ledger.expenses`. The investment-score reads from the *same* ledger lines (wages, facility, medical, sponsorship-attractiveness). Building the score *first* means we have the consumer ready when the medical line lands.
- Tier moves things downstream (TV revenue, sponsorship floors, starting cash) — if we ship Medical alone with a static tier, the user can pump €5M into medical at Tier D and never see promotion. That breaks the FM promise.
- Front Office UI gets *one* refactor pass for both features at the same time, instead of two.

---

## Acceptance Criteria

### Medical Budget (Slice 2)
- **AC-M1** New `tycoon.medicalBudget: number` field (EUR/year, default €500K, slider range €100K – €5M)
- **AC-M2** `medicalQuality(team)` returns 0..1 score. €100K → 0.0, €1M → 0.4, €2M → 0.6, €5M+ asymptotic → 1.0 (`sqrt(budget/5_000_000)` clamped)
- **AC-M3** `InjurySystem.checkInjuries` reduces `injuryRate` by up to 30% (`× (1 - quality × 0.30)`)
- **AC-M4** `InjurySystem` reduces non-season-ending `gamesRemaining` by up to 15% (`× (1 - quality × 0.15)` after `enforceSeasonEndingMinimum`)
- **AC-M5** `MedicalCard` component in Front Office: slider, current quality bar, prose label ("Premium sport-science staff — 28% fewer injuries, 12% faster recovery"). No raw multipliers on screen (UI-internals rule).
- **AC-M6** Annual ledger has new `expenses.medical` line. Wired into Annual Projection card.
- **AC-M7** AI teams use a tier-default budget for now (Tier S = €3M, Tier D = €200K) — not a smart-decision yet, just baseline.

### Dynamic Tier (Slice 1)
- **AC-T1** New `tycoon.prestigeScore: number` (0..1, EMA-blended)
- **AC-T2** `computePrestigeScore(team, league-context)` blends:
  - `investmentEMA` (rolling 3-year avg of `(wages + facility + medical + sponsorship-spend) / tier-S-baseline`)
  - `successScore` (recentEndesaPositions + recentEuroleagueStages already exist)
  - `cityPrestige` (existing static)
  - weights: 0.40 investment + 0.35 success + 0.25 city
- **AC-T3** `resolveTier(prestigeScore)` returns S/A/B/C/D from thresholds (S ≥ 0.80, A ≥ 0.60, B ≥ 0.42, C ≥ 0.25, else D)
- **AC-T4** Year-end rollover recomputes prestigeScore + tier for every Euro team. **Hysteresis:** promotion requires score above threshold *plus* +0.05 buffer; demotion requires score below threshold *minus* 0.05. Prevents flicker.
- **AC-T5** News-feed event when tier changes (`"📈 Río Breogán promoted to Tier C — investment paying off"` / `"📉 Real Madrid relegated to Tier A — board concerned"`).
- **AC-T6** Existing static `getTierForClub` becomes *initial* tier (seed only). After year 1, tier is fully dynamic.
- **AC-T7** All consumers of `team.tycoon.tier` (sponsorshipEngine, facilityEngine, budgetEngine) keep working unchanged — they just read the now-mutable field.
- **AC-T8** Migration: existing saves get `prestigeScore` backfilled from current tier (`TIER_PRESTIGE_DEFAULT[tier]` as starting value).

### Cross-cutting
- **AC-X1** No regressions in existing budget tests (`scripts/test-tycoon-sponsor.ts`).
- **AC-X2** Front Office card order: Annual Projection → Sponsorship + Medical (grid) → Travel Logistics → Ledger History.
- **AC-X3** UI never shows raw `prestigeScore` number or `medicalQuality` float. Always wrapped in prose/labels.

---

## Design — Slice 1: Dynamic Tier

### Score formula
```
investmentEMA = mean(last3.spend_per_year / TIER_S_BASELINE_SPEND)
successScore  = endesa_success(recentEndesaPositions) × 0.5 + euroleague_success(recentEuroleagueStages) × 0.5
prestigeScore = 0.40 × clamp(investmentEMA, 0, 1)
              + 0.35 × clamp(successScore,   0, 1)
              + 0.25 × cityPrestige   // already 0..1
```

`TIER_S_BASELINE_SPEND` ≈ Madrid's annual outlay (€50M wages + €5M facility + €3M medical + €5M sponsor-fees ≈ €63M target). Anything spending €63M+ trends toward tier S. Tier D clubs spend ~€8M total → 0.13 raw → contributes 0.05 to score.

### Hysteresis bands (prevents tier flicker)
| Tier | Promote-in if score ≥ | Demote-out if score < |
|------|------------------------|------------------------|
| S    | 0.85                   | 0.75                   |
| A    | 0.65                   | 0.55                   |
| B    | 0.47                   | 0.37                   |
| C    | 0.30                   | 0.20                   |
| D    | (floor)                | —                      |

### New file: `src/services/tycoon/prestigeEngine.ts`
```ts
export interface PrestigeContext {
  team: NBATeam;
  ledgerHistory: AnnualLedger[];
  recentEndesa: number[];
  recentEuro: ('final-four' | 'qf' | 'group' | 'none')[];
  cityPrestige: number;
}

export function computeInvestmentEMA(history: AnnualLedger[]): number { ... }
export function computeSuccessScore(endesa: number[], euro: string[]): number { ... }
export function computePrestigeScore(ctx: PrestigeContext): number { ... }
export function resolveTier(prevTier: TycoonTier, score: number): TycoonTier { ... }  // with hysteresis
export function recomputeTierAtYearEnd(team: NBATeam, ctx: PrestigeContext): { newTier: TycoonTier; changed: boolean } { ... }
```

### Files touched
- `src/types/tycoon.ts` — add `prestigeScore?: number`
- `src/services/tycoon/prestigeEngine.ts` — **new**
- `src/services/tycoon/migrate.ts` — backfill `prestigeScore` from `TIER_PRESTIGE_DEFAULT`
- `src/services/logic/seasonRollover.ts` — call `recomputeTierAtYearEnd` per Euro team (right after `recentEndesaPositions`/`recentEuroleagueStages` are appended, line ~1194)
- `src/services/news/newsTemplates.ts` (or wherever Euro news events emit) — promotion/demotion templates

---

## Design — Slice 2: Medical Budget

### Quality curve
```
quality(budget) = clamp(sqrt(budget / 5_000_000), 0, 1)
```
| Budget   | Quality |
|----------|---------|
| €100K    | 0.14    |
| €500K    | 0.32    |
| €1M      | 0.45    |
| €2M      | 0.63    |
| €3M      | 0.77    |
| €5M      | 1.00    |
| €10M     | 1.00 (capped) |

Diminishing returns curve — first euro is more valuable than the last.

### Injury hooks
In `InjurySystem.checkInjuries`, after existing `injuryRate` calculations:
```ts
const medicalQ = medicalQuality(team);  // team-scoped — passed in or looked up
injuryRate *= (1 - medicalQ * 0.30);     // up to 30% rate reduction
```

After `enforceSeasonEndingMinimum`:
```ts
const recoveryReduction = 1 - medicalQ * 0.15;
result.gamesRemaining = isSeasonEnding
  ? result.gamesRemaining                       // unchanged for ACL/Achilles
  : Math.max(1, Math.round(result.gamesRemaining * recoveryReduction));
```

### UI: MedicalCard
- Single section
- Annual budget slider (€100K – €5M, snap to €100K)
- Prose label, no numbers:
  - 0–0.25 quality → "Replacement-level staff — frequent injuries, slow recovery"
  - 0.25–0.50 → "Solid medical team — average injury management"
  - 0.50–0.75 → "Strong sport-science investment — measurably healthier roster"
  - 0.75–1.0  → "Elite performance lab — league-best recovery times"
- Optional bullet under: "Quality affects injury prevention and recovery only — does not impact season-ending injuries (ACL, Achilles, etc.)"

### Files touched
- `src/types/tycoon.ts` — add `medicalBudget?: number`
- `src/services/tycoon/medicalEngine.ts` — **new** (`medicalQuality`, defaults table)
- `src/services/tycoon/budgetEngine.ts` — add `expenses.medical = team.tycoon.medicalBudget ?? defaultForTier(tier)`
- `src/services/simulation/InjurySystem.ts` — accept `medicalQuality` arg, apply hooks
- `src/services/simulation/GameSimulator/engine.ts` + `RealisticEngine.ts` — pass `medicalQuality` per team into `InjurySystem.checkInjuries`
- `src/components/tycoon/MedicalCard.tsx` — **new**
- `src/components/central/view/FrontOfficeView.tsx` — render `<MedicalCard>` next to Sponsorship/Travel
- `src/components/central/view/TeamFinancesViewDetailed.tsx` — render `<MedicalCard readOnly>`
- `src/store/useGameActions.ts` — slider mutation handler (already has `applyTycoonMutation`)

---

## Implementation Order

```
1.  AC-M1, AC-T1, AC-T8       Types + migration scaffolding (no behavior change yet)
2.  AC-M2, AC-M6              medicalEngine.ts + ledger.expenses.medical wiring
3.  AC-T2, AC-T3, AC-T4       prestigeEngine.ts (pure functions, unit-testable)
4.  AC-M3, AC-M4              InjurySystem.ts hooks + engine plumb-through
5.  AC-T5                     News-feed events
6.  AC-T6, AC-T7              Year-end recompute in seasonRollover.ts
7.  AC-M5, AC-M7              MedicalCard UI + AI defaults
8.  AC-X1, AC-X3              Test pass + UI-internals audit
```

Steps 1–3 are pure data/logic; can be one PR or one session. Steps 4–6 are the integration layer. Step 7 is UI. Step 8 is verification.

---

## Goal

Three coupled features that move the Euro-Tycoon system from a *static-tier-lookup* model to a *Football-Manager-style investment-freedom* model:

1. **Medical Budget Slider** — user invests annual EUR in medical/recovery staff. Investment lowers `injuryRate` (prevention) and `gamesRemaining` (recovery time). Same UX as the existing sponsorship/ticket-price sliders, plumbed into `InjurySystem.ts`.

2. **Cash-Gate / Bankruptcy = Natural Progression** — there is **no tier-promotion mechanic**. Tier-S/A/B/C/D stays as a cosmetic starting label (and initial sponsorship pool). A D-tier club can invest in S-tier stadium upgrades or €5M medical staff — they will just go bankrupt if they can't afford it. The bankruptcy risk + owner pressure IS the progression cap. Sponsor offers respond to *actual investment levels + recent success*, not to a tier label.

3. **Euro-Mode Min-Salary Floor Fix** — `getContractLimits` currently returns NBA-min (~€1.06M shown) for Euro-mode signings. Real Euroleague min: €50K (Y1) – €110K (Y5+) net. ACB sits below. Add league-aware floor + extend Commissioner-Settings modal so the user can tune league-specific values.

All three ship in one plan because they share state (Cash-on-Hand drives bankruptcy + medical budget is a new annual cash-out + Commissioner-Settings UI gets one refactor pass).

---

## Why no tier-promotion

The original v1 of this plan proposed a `prestigeScore` that recomputed tier each year-end based on investment + success. **User killed that** with the observation: *"D-level tier can invest in S-tier stadium — but they will go bankrupt. Same with medical. Why promotion shit."*

This is correct:
- Tier was always just a starting label + sponsor-pool seed.
- Once Year 1 ends, what actually matters is **cash position + objective investment levels**.
- Sponsors don't need to know "your tier" — they look at your stadium capacity, your recent results, your city prestige.
- If Río Breogán somehow runs €5M medical + €30M stadium upgrade while staying solvent (e.g. won Euroleague three years running, big TV income), they ARE an S-tier club by every measurable metric — no label flip needed.
- If they overspend without the income to back it up, they go bankrupt. That's the FM-promise: *freedom + consequences*, not *gated promotion*.

So the plan drops `prestigeScore` and tier-recompute entirely. Tier stays static. Sponsor floors get computed from objective levers.

## Design — Slice A: Medical Budget (unchanged from v1)

### Quality curve
```
quality(budget) = clamp(sqrt(budget / 5_000_000), 0, 1)
```
| Budget   | Quality | Prose Label                                              |
|----------|---------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| €100K    | 0.14    | "Skeleton medical staff — frequent injuries"             |
| €500K    | 0.32    | "Below-average sports-medicine investment"               |
| €1M      | 0.45    | "Solid medical team"                                     |
| €2M      | 0.63    | "Strong sport-science investment"                        |
| €5M      | 1.00    | "Elite performance lab — league-best recovery times"     |
| €10M     | 1.00    | (same — diminishing returns past €5M)                    |

### Injury hooks
```ts
const medicalQ = medicalQuality(team);
injuryRate *= (1 - medicalQ * 0.30);                                  // up to 30% rate reduction

// After enforceSeasonEndingMinimum:
const recoveryReduction = 1 - medicalQ * 0.15;
result.gamesRemaining = isSeasonEnding
  ? result.gamesRemaining
  : Math.max(1, Math.round(result.gamesRemaining * recoveryReduction));
```

## Design — Slice B: Cash-Gate

### Projected cash check
```ts
function projectYearEndCash(team: NBATeam, plannedSpend: number): number {
  const tycoon = team.tycoon!;
  const annualBudget = computeAnnualBudget(team, ctx);
  return tycoon.cashOnHand + annualBudget.profit - plannedSpend;
}
```

### SigningModal banner
When `projectYearEndCash < 0`:
```
🟡 Owner concerned — this contract pushes you €X.XM into the red
   Signing it anyway will damage board confidence and increase firing risk.
   [Sign anyway]   [Cancel]
```

### Sponsor floor formula (replaces TIER_BASE[tier].sponsorshipFloor lookup)
```ts
function sponsorFloor(team: NBATeam, slot: SponsorshipSlot): number {
  const tycoon = team.tycoon!;
  const baseFloor = TIER_BASE[tycoon.tier].sponsorshipFloor[slot];  // starting tier still seeds the floor
  const stadiumBonus  = 0.10 * (tycoon.facilities.stadium.level - 1);   // +10% per level
  const successScore  = computeSuccessScore(team.recentEndesa, team.recentEuro); // existing
  const successBonus  = 0.15 * successScore;
  const cityBonus     = 0.20 * tycoon.cityPrestige!;
  return baseFloor * (1 + stadiumBonus + successBonus + cityBonus);
}
```

Starting Madrid (S-tier, stadium L1, no success yet, cityPrestige 1.0): `baseFloor × (1 + 0 + 0 + 0.20)` = +20% from city alone. Old formula gave baseFloor flat. Need to **rebalance baseFloor down by 20%** so Madrid Year 1 offers don't suddenly inflate. Easy adjustment — divide TIER_BASE values by 1.20 once during migration, or hardcode the new scaled values.

Rio Breogán (D-tier, stadium L1, no success, cityPrestige 0.35): baseFloor × (1 + 0 + 0 + 0.07) = +7%. Slight bump. After 3 years of EL Final Four + stadium L4: `1 + 0.30 + 0.225 + 0.07` = +60%. Now their D-tier sponsor pool offers more — without ever changing the "tier" label.

  ? EXTERNAL_SALARY_SCALE[detectEuroLeague(player, leagueStats)] ?? EXTERNAL_SALARY_SCALE.Endesa

   - **BBGM-lens** (sim depth): Does the underlying math still feel authentic? Are the numbers grounded in real basketball/finance reality? Would a sim-nerd respect it?
   - **FM-lens** (management depth): Does the decision matter? Are there trade-offs? Is there a clear cause-effect chain (this signing → that cash drain → that mood shift → that performance dip)?
   - **FIFA-lens** (polish + feel-good UX): Is the click satisfying? Does it look good? Is the feedback immediate and clear? Would this look good in a YouTube highlight reel?
   - **Game-tester lens**: Could a new user navigate this without confusion? Is there a "huh?" moment? A missing back-button? An unexplained number? Fix it.
   - **YouTuber lens**: Would this scene make a good "look at this!" moment? Is the drama legible? Does failure feel narratively meaningful (bankruptcy = real stakes, not just a number going red)?

   Concrete heuristics:
   - Every new screen: would I understand it in 5 seconds? if not, add a 1-line subtitle
   - Every new number: is it labeled with prose (no raw multipliers)? does it have a color cue (🟢🟡🔴)?
   - Every new modal: does dismissing it feel safe (no surprise destruction)?
   - Every new feature: does it create a story moment (LeBron-to-Madrid, bankruptcy game-over, Wilkins-effect promotion)?
   - Complexity is OK — but only when layered (easy to start, deep to master). NEVER dumb things down to hide complexity; surface it gracefully.

   Codex should self-audit each completed Goal against these lenses before marking it done in PROGRESS.md. If any lens fails, iterate before claiming completion.

# Zustand Migration — Plan

> **Wann ausführen:** NACH der Euro-Overnight-Welle (`plans/codex-overnight-goal.md`). Nicht parallel.
>
> **Design North Star:** der gesamte Game-State (Players / Teams / League / Schedule / History / Negotiations / Sponsorships / Tycoon / UI) wandert in einen Zustand-Store, organisiert per Slice. `GameContext` wird zum Compatibility-Shim und am Ende komplett ausgemustert.

## Locked Decisions (Session 2026-05-13)

1. **Strangler-Fig Migration** — `useGame()` bleibt als Compatibility-Shim, der intern `useGameStore` queryt. Bestehende ~hundreds Consumer funktionieren weiter ohne Touch. Neue Components nutzen direkt `useGameStore(selector)`. Migration ist inkrementell pro Component.
2. **Custom Storage Adapter** — Zustand `persist` middleware mit einem Adapter, der intern `SaveManager.compress()` + `idb-keyval` + Multi-Save-Bucketing nutzt. Saves bleiben gzipped + save-id-scoped.
3. **Pilot: 11 isolated stores zuerst** — `gameplanStore`, `coachSystemStore`, `coachStrategyLockStore`, `defenderDetailStore`, `defenseGameplanStore`, `idealRotationStore`, `matchupAssignmentsStore`, `rivalGameplanStore`, `scoringOptionsStore`, `tradingBlockStore`, `saveScopedMapStore`. Niedrigstes Regression-Risk, perfekter Adapter-Validation-Pilot.

## Phase 1 — Pilot: Die 11 isolated Stores (1–2 Sessions)

**Ziel:** Pattern + Adapter validieren ohne Main-State anzufassen.

**Konkret:**
- `pnpm add zustand` (auch wenn schon installiert → check `package.json`)
- Pro Store-Datei: ersetze handgerollte `subscribers + getState + setState + useSyncExternalStore` durch `create()` mit `persist` middleware
- Custom Adapter: `src/store/persistence/saveScopedLocalStorage.ts` — wrappt localStorage + saveId-bucket-Logik (genau wie heute, nur als Zustand-Storage-Adapter)
- API-Compat: jeder Store exportiert weiterhin `getX()` / `setX()` / `subscribeX()` als Wrapper für nicht-React-Aufrufer (StatGenerator, sim engine), plus neuen `useXStore` hook für React
- Verify pro Store: localStorage bucket per saveId identisch wie heute (Pre/Post-Migration-Snapshot vergleichen)
- Files to touch:
  - `src/store/gameplanStore.ts` + `coachSystemStore.ts` + `coachStrategyLockStore.ts` + `defenderDetailStore.ts` + `defenseGameplanStore.ts` + `idealRotationStore.ts` + `matchupAssignmentsStore.ts` + `rivalGameplanStore.ts` + `scoringOptionsStore.ts` + `tradingBlockStore.ts` + `saveScopedMapStore.ts`
  - New: `src/store/persistence/saveScopedLocalStorage.ts`
- Zero Touch auf `GameContext`, `useGameActions`, Consumer-Components
- Acceptance: alle Coaching/Trading-Block/Defender-Detail UIs identisch funktional, saves persist gleich, localStorage-Buckets identisch byte-für-byte

## Phase 2 — Custom IDB Adapter + Main Store Skelett (1 Session)

**Ziel:** Den Main-Store anlegen (leer) + den IDB-gzip-Adapter implementieren, bevor Slices migrieren.

- `src/store/persistence/gzipIdbAdapter.ts` — Zustand `StateStorage`-Adapter:
  - `getItem(name)` → IDB `get(name)` → DecompressionStream gzip → JSON.parse
  - `setItem(name, value)` → JSON.stringify → CompressionStream gzip → IDB `set(name, ArrayBuffer)`
  - `removeItem(name)` → IDB `del(name)`
  - Schreibt das `{ __gz: true, data: ArrayBuffer }`-Format genau wie heute (siehe CLAUDE.md Save Format Section)
- `src/store/useGameStore.ts` — initial leerer Store mit Slice-Composition-Skelett, persist disabled bis Slices migriert sind
- Tests: load-existing-save via Adapter → state struct identisch zum Pre-Migration-State (deep-equal-Snapshot)
- Verify: Roundtrip eines Test-Saves bricht keine bestehende Logik (alter GameContext nutzt es noch nicht)

## Phase 3 — UI Slice (1 Session)

**Ziel:** Niedrigster-Risk-Slice als Strangler-Fig-Validation. Beweist dass Compat-Shim funktioniert.

- New: `src/store/slices/uiSlice.ts` — modalState, navigation-current-route, prefs, suppressFinanceRecapUntil, etc.
- `useGame()` Shim updated: liest `uiPrefs`-Reads aus `useGameStore.getState().ui.*`, Writes dispatchen via Slice-Actions
- Beweist: ein Slice live in production, useGame-Consumer agnostic, kein UI-Regression

## Phase 4 — Domain Slices (5–8 Sessions, in Reihenfolge)

Pro Slice: anlegen → useGame Shim umroutet → Consumer-Migration optional → alte GameContext-State-Field deprecated.

1. **`createNegotiationSlice`** — signings + sponsor-neg + trade-talks (Overnight-Codex baut neue Negotiation-Features eh; Zustand-native macht's sauberer)
2. **`createTeamSlice`** — teams + tycoon + staffing + facilities
3. **`createLeagueSlice`** — leagueStats + schedule + standings + competitions + calendar
4. **`createPlayerSlice`** — players + stats + ratings + relatives + moodTraits (höchstes Volumen, höchste Selector-Win)
5. **`createHistorySlice`** — history + awards + retired + transactions + boxScores
6. **`createScheduleSlice`** — schedule + competitionRows + matchdays (kann auch Teil von League sein; split nur wenn Selector-Hot-Path)
7. **`createCommissionerSlice`** — rules, settings, commissioner-only state

Acceptance pro Slice: getätigte Mutations laufen über Slice-Actions, alle bestehenden useGame-Reads liefern identische Werte, Test-Save roundtrips deep-equal.

## Phase 5 — GameContext Sunset (1 Session)

- Wenn ALLE State-Fields in Slices leben: GameContext-Wrapper enthält nur noch Refs + Lifecycle + Callbacks (nicht-State)
- useGame() Shim returnt jetzt eine kombinierte Selector-Aggregation für Legacy-Consumer
- Consumer-Migration optional (rein Performance — Selector-Renders pro Consumer-Touch)
- Long-term: useGame() deprecated, neue Components nutzen direkt slice-spezifische Hooks (`useTycoon()`, `usePlayers()`, etc.)

## Phase 6 — Selector Migration (Ongoing, Multi-Session)

Pro Hot-Path-Component (Schedule-Calendar, Front-Office-Live-Updates, Trade-Hub, Player-Bio-Lists): useGame() → useGameStore-Selector. Erkennbarer FPS-Win in DevTools-Profiler. Kein Big-Bang — touched-when-touched.

## API-Compat-Shim Spec

```ts
// src/store/GameContext.tsx (post Phase 3+)
export const useGame = () => {
  const state = useGameStore();           // Full state — kein Selector, bewusst
  const dispatch = useGameStore(s => s.dispatch);
  const applyTycoonMutation = useGameStore(s => s.applyTycoonMutation);
  // ... weitere existing-API-Funktionen
  return { state, dispatch, applyTycoonMutation, /* ... */ };
};
```

Bestehende Components funktionieren ohne Änderung. Nur ineffizient (Full-State-Subscription). Migration zu Selectoren ist optional und inkrementell.

## Was nicht migriert wird (Out of Scope)

- **`SaveManager.ts`** Core-Funktionalität: bleibt für Multi-Save-Listing, Metadata-Verwaltung, Export/Import. Zustand-Adapter ruft `SaveManager.compress/decompress` intern auf — keine doppelte Pipeline.
- **`useGameActions.ts`** Action-Set: wandert progressive in Slice-Actions, aber alte Aufrufer (`useGameActions().applyTycoonMutation(...)`) bleiben via Shim funktional.
- **`logic/turn/postProcessor.ts`** + Sim-Engine: keine React-Components, lesen direkt aus `getState()` — nur API-Compat-Shim nötig (`getState()` returnt heutige State-Shape).

## Stopping Conditions

- [ ] Phase 1: alle 11 isolated stores migrated, alle saves identisch byte-für-byte
- [ ] Phase 2: gzipIdbAdapter roundtrip-tested mit production-Save
- [ ] Phase 3: uiSlice live, kein UI-Regression in 1-Wochen-QA-Run
- [ ] Phase 4 (per Slice): Slice live, alle useGame-Consumer agnostic, deep-equal-Snapshot vs pre-migration-State
- [ ] Phase 5: GameContext nur noch Lifecycle/Refs, kein State
- [ ] Acceptance-Test: lädt 12-month-Save, simuliert 1 Season, alle Lederger-Numbers + Standings identisch vs Pre-Migration-Snapshot

## Risiken & Gegenmaßnahmen

- **Save-Korruption** durch falschen Adapter → Phase 2 dedicated Adapter-Test mit 5 verschiedenen Saves vor Production-Use
- **Performance-Regression** durch Full-State-Subscriptions via Shim → akzeptabel während Migration, Selector-Migration in Phase 6 fixt's
- **Verlust handgerollter Optimierungen** (z.B. saveScopedMapStore custom buckets) → Adapter testet bucket-Layout bit-genau

## Memory & Documentation

- Update `CLAUDE.md` mit Zustand-Pattern + Save-Adapter-Hinweis nach Phase 2
- Update `MEMORY.md` Index mit `project_zustand_migration.md` (status-tracker per Phase)
- Touch `TODO.md` per Phase-Completion

## EURO MODE BACKLOG (May 2026 — captured during overnight planning session)

### Backlog idea — Hotel/Flight Mood Coupling + Survival-Mode Death-Spiral

**Status:** brainstorm-only. Codex Goal 17 will write `plans/euro-hotel-mood.md` with AC list during overnight session. No code yet.

Two coupled mechanics that turn the existing TravelLogistics tiers into real consequences:

**(A) Hotel/Flight → Player Mood.** Low-tier travel (Bus/2-star hotel/Economy flights) hits player morale, especially stars (K2 ≥ 75). Open questions: who cares (stars > role players), how much (mood −1 per away game in low-tier?), thresholds (1-star hotel → complaint event after N trips?), interaction with `roleStability` + `moodTraits`.

**(B) Forced downgrade on low cash (Survival Mode).** When `cashOnHand < ~€2M` (1 monthly payslip), TravelLogistics tiers AUTO-DOWNGRADE. Red banner: *"Survival mode — cash forces economy class + 1-star hotel."* Sliders lock at low position. Combines with (A) → mood crash → performance drop → less prize money → cash stays low → DEATH SPIRAL.

**Recovery:** improve cash above threshold → sliders unlock → can re-upgrade. **Sponsor buffer:** travel sponsor (if signed) overrides forced economy — "Iberia covers flights" disclosure card.

**Why worth building:** turns the cosmetic Travel-tier selection into a genuine stake. Loss of momentum becomes visible AND playable (you can fight your way out). FIFA-tier polish + FM-tier consequence chain.

---

### Backlog idea — Bankruptcy → "Choose Your Next Team" (Euro mode locked design)

**Status:** Goal 3 in `plans/codex-overnight-goal.md`. Locked design per `project_euro_bankruptcy_progression` memory.

Replaces NBA-style firing/career-end. When `tycoon.cashOnHand < 0` at season rollover (Euro + GM mode), trigger `BANKRUPTCY_CHOOSE_TEAM` offseason task:

- Modal lists all other Euro teams (Endesa + Euroleague + future LEB Oro), sorted by `cityPrestige` desc
- User clicks → dispatch `SET_USER_TEAM_ID`, mark old team `aiManaged: true`
- News event: *"Río Breogán filed for bankruptcy — you've been hired as GM of {new team}"*
- Tier of new team is STATIC start label, NOT promotable. Bankruptcy is the only cap.
- Game continues without prestige-loss, save-deletion, or career-end-screen — narratively a new chapter, mechanically a re-anchor

**Why this is the cleanest failure-mode:** preserves run continuity (no save invalidation), creates a real story arc ("from Tier-C disaster to S-tier comeback"), and respects that the game is single-save-per-club. Better than Football Manager's "fired → loading screen → new club" loop because the user's *commissioner-level history* stays visible across teams.

**Defer follow-ups:** Board-Sacking (F3) and Ownership-Change (F4) failure-modes — separate from bankruptcy, lower priority. Currently OUT of scope for v1.

---

### Backlog idea — Buyout Clauses (Euro-style transfer market)

**Status:** Optional Bonus Goal B3 in overnight plan. Deferred unless Codex finishes 1-17.

Real Euroleague + Endesa precedent: every contract has a publicly-known `buyoutClauseUSD` field. Rival clubs can pay it *unilaterally* to sign the player — the original team has no say beyond setting the clause amount at signing time.

**Mechanic:**
- New `contract.buyoutClauseUSD?: number` field — set at signing, optional (NBA contracts won't have one)
- During free agency OR mid-season window: rival club pays clause → contract auto-terminates → player becomes signable
- Original club receives clause amount as `revenue.transfer` in ledger (already a field!)
- AI clubs trigger buyouts based on cash-on-hand + roster-need score
- User-mode: opens a "Trigger Buyout?" modal when a target's clause is meetable

**Drama hooks:**
- Shams template: *"FC Barcelona triggered the €12M buyout clause on Mike James — Madrid loses their star without negotiation rights."*
- Owner-confidence hit on the losing side (lost asset for fixed price below market value)
- Sponsor-mood penalty if marquee star buyout-walked (BBVA "concerned about brand visibility")

**Why worth building:** creates a uniquely European transfer-market texture that NBA mode doesn't have. Composes with sponsor-personality system — premium sponsors care WHO is on roster, buyouts threaten that. Direct counter to "Real Madrid stockpiles everyone forever."

---

### Backlog idea — Installment Transfer Payments + Contract Amortisation (FFP)

**Status:** Optional Bonus Goals B6 + B7. Deferred. Useful only if buyout system above ships first.

**B6 — Installment payments:** transfer/buyout fees split 40/30/30 over 3 years instead of cash-up-front. Buyer's P&L recognizes installments year-by-year. Seller's `tycoon.expectedTransferIncome[]` tracks pending receivables.

**B7 — Contract amortisation:** a 5-year €25M deal spreads as €5M/year on the FFP P&L (separate ledger line from `revenue.transfer` cash-paid). Mirrors UEFA/Euroleague FFP rules. Lets clubs front-load talent acquisition without hitting cash crunch immediately, but creates locked-in future expense recognition.

**Why both worth building:** turns the bankruptcy clock into a *strategic* timing game. Today the only cash-flow lever is sponsor-revenue + payslip-bleed. Adding installments + amortisation lets a GM choose "front-load the talent, ride the amortisation tail, hope sponsors catch up" vs "stay liquid, never gamble."

**Defer until:** buyouts shipped + FinanceRecapModal (Goal 6) mature enough to surface multi-year obligations clearly.

---

### Backlog idea — Foreign Affiliates (sponsor-multiplier hook)

**Status:** Optional Bonus Goal B8. Deferred.

Real precedent: many Euroleague clubs have affiliate-club agreements with overseas teams (Real Madrid ↔ Sloan Pacific League, FC Barcelona ↔ academies in Africa). Cheap one-shot action: "Establish affiliation with FC Tokyo" → small boost to sponsor-renewal multiplier for sponsors with Japan-market exposure (Mitsubishi, ANA, etc.).

**Mechanic:**
- `team.tycoon.affiliations: string[]` — region or club codes
- Sponsor seed-pool tagged with `foreignMarketTags: string[]`
- During sponsor-renewal: matching tag × affiliation → +5-12% offer value
- Cost: one-time €500K-€2M depending on tier of affiliate club

**Why worth building:** light-touch globalization feature. Lets the user shape *brand strategy* (be the Spanish club that's also a Japan-market darling) without adding heavy new state. Pairs nicely with `BRAND IMPACT` panel in Sponsor-Negotiation Modal — affiliate-tagged sponsors show "Worldwide reach: ↑ via Tokyo affiliation."

---

### Backlog idea — Relegation Endesa ↔ LEB Oro

**Status:** Future deferred (F2 in overnight plan). Not for v1 Euro Mode.

Spain's basketball league system has promotion/relegation: bottom 2 of Liga Endesa → LEB Oro (2nd division), top 2 of LEB Oro → Endesa.

**Mechanic** (when shipped):
- Bottom-2 finishers in Endesa get relegated; their roster mostly stays but tier drops one level → smaller sponsor pool, lower TV revenue, often forced asset-sales
- Top-2 in LEB Oro promote → expanded sponsor pool, bigger budget, signing-power boost
- LEB Oro is itself a generated league (~16 clubs), simpler than Endesa but real
- Could chain to LEB Plata (3rd div) but unnecessary for v1

**Why deferred:** requires building LEB Oro as a full secondary league (~16 NonNBATeam entries with rosters, sponsors, calendar). Big content-creation lift. Worth doing only when Euro mode core (sponsorships + medical + travel + finance recap) is stable and users are asking "what's the next horizon?"

**Pairs with:** Bankruptcy choose-team modal could include LEB Oro teams as "rebuild-from-the-bottom" options.

---

## ARCHITECTURE BACKLOG (May 2026 — captured during Zustand discussion)

> These are pure technical investments. None ship user-facing features. They unlock maintainability + perf headroom for the next year of feature work. Listed in priority order.

### Architecture — Zustand State Migration (Strangler-Fig pattern)

**Status:** plan locked in `plans/zustand-migration.md`. Not started. Phase 1 (11 isolated stores) is the agreed-upon pilot.

**Why:** today the entire game state lives in one big `GameContext` object — every `useGame()` consumer re-renders on any state change. Selector-based subscriptions (Zustand's core win) would eliminate re-render storms in hot paths: Schedule Calendar (30+ day-cells re-rendering on every sim-tick), Live Ledger (full Front Office View re-rendering on every cashOnHand update), Player Bios list (1500 rows re-rendering on every mood-change). Plus 11 handgerollte stores (`gameplanStore`, `coachSystemStore`, etc.) all duplicate the same `subscribers + setState + useSyncExternalStore` boilerplate — Zustand replaces that boilerplate with `create((set) => ({...}))` in 5 lines.

**Migration story:** Theseus' Ship. `useGame()` becomes a compat-shim that internally queries `useGameStore`. Every existing consumer keeps working unchanged. New consumers (and migrated hot-paths) read directly from selectors. 5-6 phases, ~10 sessions total, fully reversible per phase.

**Phase 1 pilot:** the 11 isolated stores → Zustand. Low regression risk (each store is self-contained). Validates the custom localStorage-adapter pattern before touching the main state.

**Custom storage adapter:** Zustand `persist` middleware wraps the existing `SaveManager.compress()` + `idb-keyval` + multi-save-bucket pipeline. Save format stays byte-identical.

**Defer:** Don't start during the Euro Mode overnight wave. Pure refactor work, no overlap with feature shipping. Begin after Codex' 19 Goals are landed and stable.

---

### Architecture — Web Worker Sim Engine (UX win, sofort spürbar)

**Status:** backlog. No file yet.

Today `simulateSeason()` blocks the main thread for 10-30 seconds. UI freezes; user stares at hanging page. Modern browsers ship Web Workers with structured-clone IPC — move `GameSimulator` into a Worker, post messages for each game-sim-tick, render progress UI on main thread.

**Concrete shape:**
- `src/services/simulation/SimWorker.ts` — Worker entry, accepts `(state, dateRange, options)`, returns deltas
- Main thread sends state-snapshot, awaits per-game result, dispatches `APPLY_GAME_RESULT` per message
- Progress bar with cancel button — user can abort mid-sim
- All `Math.random()` seeded for determinism so worker output matches main-thread output bit-for-bit

**Why it's the biggest UX win on the list:** every sim-block today is a *jank moment*. Moving to worker means smooth UI during multi-day Sims, animated progress, cancel-button safety. This is the move that makes the game feel "professional" instead of "amateur."

**Risk:** Worker IPC has serialization cost. For our state size (~5-15 MB gzipped) the upfront `postMessage` could be slow. Mitigation: send incremental deltas instead of full state, OR use `SharedArrayBuffer` if available.

**Defer until:** post-Zustand migration. Zustand's selector pattern makes state-slicing easier, which makes worker-state-transfer cleaner.

---

### Architecture — Save Versioning + Auto-Migration Framework

**Status:** backlog. No file yet.

Today every schema change ships ad-hoc migration code in `LOAD_GAME`. See `rookieContractUtils` USD-vs-millions bug, `born.year` drift on old saves, `medicalBudget` backfill, etc. Each migration is one-off, undocumented, untested.

**Concrete shape:**
- `src/services/migrations/` folder with numbered files: `001_add_medicalBudget.ts`, `002_split_contractYears.ts`, `003_backfill_born_year.ts`, etc.
- Each migration: `function migrate(state: any): any` with version-up
- Save metadata gains `schemaVersion: number` field
- On `LOAD_GAME`: detect current version, run all migrations from saved-version → latest, save back at latest-version
- Migrations are *reviewable* (one PR per migration), *testable* (snapshot of save before/after), *rollback-able* (can downgrade if version was bumped wrongly)

**Why worth building:** several existing bugs in `CLAUDE.md` Critical-Mistakes section trace directly to "old save has missing field, new code crashes." A migration framework prevents this whole bug class going forward.

**Pairs with:** Zustand `persist` middleware has a built-in `migrate` callback — natural place to hook the framework in.

---

### Architecture — xstate Flow Machines (offseason/draft/expansion/trade)

**Status:** backlog. No file yet.

Today complex multi-step flows are nested guard-clauses + ad-hoc state-fields: `pendingOptionDecisions`, `pendingQOs`, `expansionPhase`, `tradeNegotiationStep`. Each flow has invariants that get checked in 10+ places. Bug-prone (see zombie-Spieler-Flag bug, double-fire offseason auto-seeding bug, etc.).

**Target:** use xstate (or zag.js for lighter-weight) to define each flow as an explicit state machine:

```ts
const offseasonMachine = createMachine({
  id: 'offseason',
  initial: 'draftLottery',
  states: {
    draftLottery: { on: { NEXT: 'options' } },
    options: { on: { NEXT: 'qualifyingOffers', SKIP: 'qualifyingOffers' } },
    qualifyingOffers: { on: { NEXT: 'myFAs' } },
    // ... etc
  }
});
```

**Why worth building:** state machines are *visualizable* (xstate has an inspector), *testable* (assert state transitions), and *fail-loud* (invalid transition = explicit error instead of silent corruption). The "extension-zombie-flag bug" wouldn't have happened with a state machine — the transition `signed → declined → resigned` would have been an explicit forbidden edge.

**Defer until:** at least one painful flow-bug ships after Euro mode launches (which it will). Reactive adoption — don't refactor working code, refactor *after* the bug pain becomes concrete.

---

### Architecture — Replay Engine (Canvas Mini-Court, FIFA-tier polish)

**Status:** backlog. Pure dream-feature, no file yet.

Today play-by-play is text-only. Lines stream past: *"LeBron drives → kicks to Reaves → Reaves 3PT → SCORES."* User has to imagine the geometry.

**Future:** Canvas-based mini-court (200×400px) with player tokens (5v5 colored dots) moving along scripted paths. Each PossessionResult writes a `replayScript: Array<{t, playerId, x, y, event}>`. Replay-modal lets user scrub/pause/2x-speed.

**Drama unlocks:**
- Highlight reels (3-4 best plays per game, auto-curated)
- Player-Bio "career highlight" tab (best clutch plays)
- YouTuber content moment ("watch the dagger 3 from Real Madrid in Euroleague Final 4")
- Marketing: GIFs/clips can be exported for social media

**Effort:** significant. ~3-4 sessions for v1 (dots-on-canvas), ~5-8 for polish (jersey numbers, ball animation, hoop celebration). But every minute of effort pays off in *legibility* of the sim — which is the #1 thing separating "data game" from "playable game."

**Defer until:** Euro mode + Zustand done. This is what comes AFTER the core sim feels good — it's the visual polish that makes a YouTuber want to record a video.

---

### Architecture — Multi-Tab Sync via BroadcastChannel

**Status:** small fix, big risk-reduction.

Today if user opens game in 2 tabs, the two GameContexts diverge silently. Next save overwrites the other with stale state → silent save corruption. The user might not notice for hours.

**Fix:** wire `BroadcastChannel('nba-commish-sync')` to fire on any state-write. Other tabs reload state or warn the user. Single-tab enforcement is also acceptable — show banner "Game is already open in another tab" and disable interactions until user closes the other tab.

**Why worth building:** prevents a class of save-corruption bugs that's nearly impossible to debug after-the-fact. Cheap to implement (~50 LoC).

**Defer until:** anyone reports a save-loss incident, or before public release if we ever ship to others.

---

### Architecture — PWA + Offline Mode

**Status:** backlog. Game already runs entirely client-side, just need Service Worker.

**Concrete:**
- Add `manifest.json` with icons, theme color, display: standalone
- Service Worker caches all static assets (JS bundle, BBGM logos, ratings gists)
- App becomes installable as native-app-like on Mobile + Desktop (PWA)
- Offline mode: once cached, no internet needed — all data is in IDB already

**Marketing win:** "Installable, offline-first basketball sim — no app store, no installer." Niche but real differentiator.

**Defer until:** before any public release. Strictly polish.

---

### Architecture — E2E Deterministic-Seed Test Harness

**Status:** backlog. No test infra for sim correctness today.

Today: no automated test asserts "Sim 1 season with seed=42 → Houston records 41-41, LeBron averages 24.3 PPG." Sim-engine regressions are caught session-late (or never).

**Future:**
- Test runner accepts a deterministic seed + duration + assertion list
- `pnpm test:sim --seed=42 --duration=82games --expect "standings.HOU=41-41,lebron.ppg≈24.3"`
- Runs in CI (or pre-commit hook for big changes)
- Snapshot-based: capture full state-deltas at season-end, diff against golden output

**Why worth building:** catches sim-engine regressions sofort. FGA v3 + tickPlayerFatigue + InjurySystem + ProgressionEngine all have subtle tuning — without snapshot tests, a 1-line change can shift the whole league's stat distribution without anyone noticing for weeks.

**Defer until:** the sim engine stabilizes more. Today's sim is still under heavy iteration; deterministic snapshots would mean constantly updating goldens. Once Euro Mode + Apron mechanics land and the engine is "done" for a stretch, snapshot tests prevent backsliding.

---

### Architecture — Cloud Saves via Supabase (opt-in)

**Status:** backlog. Privacy-first opt-in.

Today saves are local IDB only. User switches Browser/Computer → save gone. User clears browser data → save gone.

**Future:** opt-in cross-device sync via Supabase (free tier sufficient for solo-dev game). User logs in with email magic-link, save uploads as gzipped blob to Supabase Storage, syncs on Load.

**Privacy:** strictly opt-in. Default-off. Local-only mode stays first-class.

**Why worth building:** retention win. Players who switch devices currently lose progress and never return. Cross-device sync is the #1 retention feature in mobile-style games.

**Defer until:** core game polish done + actual users exist who want this. Premature for solo-dev still in feature-build mode.

---

# Changelog — NBA Commish Sim

Historical bug fixes, session notes, and architecture discoveries.

## Session 67 (May 14, 2026) — Euro Transfer Market wired live + surgical fixes

- `src/types.ts`, `src/store/initialState.ts`, `src/store/GameContext.tsx` — added `TransferListing` / `TransferBid` types and `transferListings` / `transferBids` / `transferActivity` arrays to `GameState`; LOAD_GAME defaults to empty so old saves migrate seamlessly. New reducer actions: `LIST_PLAYER_FOR_TRANSFER`, `CANCEL_TRANSFER_LISTING`, `SUBMIT_TRANSFER_BID`, `ACCEPT_TRANSFER_BID`, `REJECT_TRANSFER_BID`. Accept executes the move: flips `player.tid`, debits buyer / credits seller `tycoon.cashOnHand` in EUR, appends an activity log entry.
- `src/services/transfer/transferMarket.ts` — service layer with selectors (`getActiveListingsForTeam`, `getInboxBidsForTeam`, `getBrowseListings`), pricing helper (`estimatePlayerValueEUR`), builders (`buildListing`, `buildBid`), tick utilities (`tickListings`, `expireOldBids`, `syncListingRollups`, `markHighest`), and unified team / payroll lookups (`resolveTeamAnywhere`, `teamCashEUR`, `teamPayrollUSDThousands`).
- `src/services/transfer/transferMarketTicker.ts` — daily AI tick: decrements listing days, expires stale bids, lets AI teams scout listings and submit bids (higher interest on user listings), auto-accepts when bids meet asking price or at auction expiry, drops ~2% chance per AI team per day of listing a surplus 60–78 OVR player. All randomness seeded by the calendar date so a re-sim is deterministic. Wired into `simulationHandler.ts` directly before playoff logic so it runs once per simulated day. Skips entirely when window is closed.
- `src/components/transferMarket/state.ts` — `TransferMarketProvider` + `useTransferMarketContext()` build the `MockPlayer` / `MockClub` / `InboxBid` / `MyListing` / `BrowseListing` / `ReleaseClause` shapes from real state (USD→EUR @ 0.92, 2K rating scale via `convertTo2KRating`, flag emoji per nationality, team color from `colors[0]`). Exposes `actions.listPlayer / cancelListing / submitBid / acceptBid / rejectBid` that wrap `dispatchAction`. The provider also resolves the listing's real `sellerTid` when a bid is submitted from Browse without it.
- `src/components/transferMarket/EuroTransferMarketView.tsx` — header, tab counts, all four tabs and the right rails now consume real state via context. `List Player` button opens a new modal with player picker (eligible roster only), asking-price stepper seeded from `estimatePlayerValueEUR`, and auction-duration chips (3/5/7/10/14 days). `Cancel`, `Accept`, `Reject`, `Place Bid` all dispatch real actions; buttons disable when the transfer window is closed; empty-states everywhere replace the old hardcoded fixtures. `mockData.ts` retains its types but is now just a type module — fixtures are unused.
- `src/types.ts`, `src/services/offseason/offseasonState.ts`, `src/components/offseason/OffseasonAufgaben.tsx` — new offseason row `transferMarket` added to `OffseasonChecklistRow`, `OFFSEASON_ROW_ORDER`, labels, descriptions, base + initial preseason checklists, navigation tab (`Front Office Transfer Market`), `getStepConfirmSpec`, and the active-step header CTA so the offseason flow surfaces a Transfer Market step between Free Agency and Training Camp.
- `src/utils/transferWindow.ts` — `isInTransferWindow` now normalizes incoming dates (accepts `YYYY-MM-DD`, en-US `"Aug 1, 2025"`, or `Date`) and falls back to `new Date()` for invalid input. Fixes a "Invalid time value" crash when the Transfer Market view was opened with `state.date` in the en-US format.
- `src/components/transferMarket/state.ts` — all `Date.toISOString()` accesses on `windowStatus.currentClose` / `.nextOpen` now go through a `safeIso` helper so Invalid Date values can never propagate to the UI.
- `src/components/central/view/FrontOfficeView.tsx` — staff signing detail modal now computes a real offer strength (`effectiveAnnual = salary + bonus/years`, length-bonus +3% per extra year) and rejects lowballs: <70% ask = "Will reject — too low" + button disabled; 70–85% = "Insulted — likely no" + disabled; 85–97% = "Tempted — coin flip"; 97–110% = "Likely"; ≥110% = "Eager — premium offer". Replaces the previously hardcoded "Likely" approval outlook.
- `src/components/central/view/FrontOfficeView.tsx` — added `scrollbar-hide` to the Front Office page wrappers so the content scrollbar no longer collides visually with the offseason aufgaben right rail.
- `src/components/transferMarket/EuroTransferMarketView.tsx` — Transfer Market scroll container uses `scrollbar-hide` for the same reason.
- `src/components/training/TrainingDayView.tsx` — `teamLookup` now includes `state.nonNBATeams` so Euro-mode opponents resolve correctly. Fixes `vs ???` in the matchup hero and `???` / `???` in the Around-the-League strip when the user team or opponent is a Euroleague / Endesa / B-League / etc. club.
